cohort.definition: External non-local sellers with a stable HTTPS origin, health at least 0.8, routable true, originResponded not false, Base mainnet in indexed networks, and at least one indexed paid tool
cohort.selection: Complete eligible cohort ordered by a fixed SHA-256 salt
cohort.probe: At most one alphabetically selected indexed paid GET route per seller, concurrency capped at three, maximum accepted price 1 USDC

limitations: This is a dated transport census, not a seller-quality or demand ranking.
One paid GET route was tested per eligible seller; POST-only sellers were not runtime tested.
Unverified does not mean broken. It means the bounded generic probe did not establish a compatible runtime offer.
Protocol support can change after the checkedAt timestamp.
